review.conversion: Lossless supported RGB8 channel/row repacking only. No premul alpha division, guessed byte order, profile transformation or reduced precision. Encoded bytes and provider metadata remain available.
review.representation: Existing Decode/default constructors remain premultiplied; DecodeStraight explicitly labels straight output. Typed Metal upload rejects premultiplied output. Copy/disposal uses a lock to avoid partial cleared snapshots.
review.native: Only unsafe use checks CGImage.Decode pointer for null; no pointer dereference. Native data/properties/source scopes disposed. Budgets constrain owned buffers, not opaque internal codec allocations.
review.remaining: Actual iOS layouts/pixels pending. Wider profile/bit-depth/palette/format conversion, original source codec/cache/GDI, visible images/document/SetView/PC/physical parity remain required.
